html:
Narendra Modi has been prime minister of India since May 2014. He is the most powerful Indian leader since Indira Gandhi and the first from the Hindu nationalist movement to win a majority of his own.

He was born in 1950 in Vadnagar, a small town in Gujarat, into a family of a low-ranked caste; his father sold tea at the railway station. As a young man he became a full-time organiser for the RSS, and from 1987 he worked for its party, the BJP.

He was made chief minister of Gujarat in 2001 and held the post for twelve years. The riots of 2002 happened months after he took office. He then built a name for roads, power and investment.

In 2014 the BJP won the first single-party majority in thirty years. It won again in 2019, and in 2024 he took a third term at the head of a coalition.

His government brought in a national sales tax, the demonetisation of 2016, and bank accounts, toilets and cooking gas for the poor on a vast scale. It also revoked Article 370 and opened the Ram temple at Ayodhya in 2024. Critics point to pressure on the press, on opponents and on Muslims.
sum: Narendra Modi has been prime minister of India since May 2014. He is the most powerful Indian leader since Indira Gandhi and the first from the Hindu nationalist movement to win a majority of his own.
